title: Brown measure convergence for the spectrum of polynomials in Ginibre matrices
summary: Fix a multivariate polynomial $\mathfrak{p}$ in $n$ non-commuting variables of arbitrary degree, and consider $n$ independent $N\times N$ complex Ginibre matrices $X_1^N,\cdots,X_n^N$. We prove that the empirical spectral distribution of $P^N=\mathfrak{p}(X_1^N,\cdots,X_n^N)$ converges as $N$ tends to infinity to the so-called Brown measure of $\mathfrak{p}$ evaluated at free circular variables. For polynomials of degree at most 2, the convergence was proven by Cook, Guionnet, and Husson \cite{cook2022spectrum}, and we prove that the convergence in fact holds for polynomials $\mathfrak{p}$…
